import json,os,signal,time
from pathlib import Path
stopping=False
seen=None
def stop(signum,frame):
 global stopping,seen
 stopping=True;seen=signum
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop)
print('CHILD_READY',flush=True)
try:
 while not stopping:signal.pause()
finally:
 time.sleep(.05)
 with Path('/tmp/owned-check/final.json').open('x') as stream:
  json.dump(dict(flushed=True,pid=os.getpid(),handled_signal=seen,final_monotonic_ns=time.monotonic_ns()),stream)
